bestBets.overview: At the time of writing (Friday) the track is rated a soft 7 but with fine weather forecast it should be on the improve. MOONYA LAD closed well to just miss when resuming. He'll only be improved and looks a strong chance to go one better. The on-pacer KARMARDO draws to advantage and will take catching if able to control the tempo. LILSISTERDON'TCHA failed to finish off last time but her previous efforts were solid. PERFECT FAWAZ placed at healthy odds fresh and can't be taken lightly this time.

raceTips.comment: Huge day of racing at Cannon Park with the running of the Amateurs Cup plus a couple of other features. Track rated a soft (6) on Friday morning however warm & sunny conditions forecast will see an upgrade. We get cracking with a 950m maiden where I'm with the lightly raced Townsville visitor Moonya Lad who was scratched from a race on his home track Tuesday to be kept for this. Placed 2 of 5 & fitter for the fresh run he looks very well placed to break through today. Karmardo & Lilsistadon'tcha in the place mix.

raceTips.comment: To the Amateurs Cup over 1900m. Seems an eternity between drinks however should Canberra Legend not be winning this or at least be in the finish his next move may well be to the picnic circuit or even over the jumps. The field is not strong, he's been competitive in far better races (albeit without winning), surely today! If not then maybe The Driller who is a 10yo now or Bluebird Bay who drops heavily in weight rising in class, not much though!

bestBets.overview: The local LAZENBY was back to his best when finishing off strongly to score over this route last time. He's yet to miss the quinella from four tries here and can go on now that his confidence is back up. KIRIKAN doesn't win out of turn but is holding form well and there's no reason to think he can't play a role in the finish again. ARCTIC BEAR has found the line well at all three runs back from a freshen and should again be strong when it counts. NOVELA has led throughout at two of three outings this time in but has the outside alley to overcome this time.

raceTips.comment: Open race to close the meeting. Arctic Bear rises in weight however drops plenty in grade. He's been strong to the line his last couple & close up all 3 starts, this suits. Kirikan holds a poor winning strike rate however is very consistent, drawn the pole maps well & gets his chance. Novella lumped the big weight to score last start, gets a little relief today.
